if (!exists("experiment", inherits = FALSE) || is.null(experiment) || !nzchar(as.character(experiment)[1]))
  stop("experiment required: set in Code Lab or assign experiment <- 'YourExp'")
b <- list(
  session_id = session_id, experiment = as.character(experiment)[1],
  taxa_level = "Genus", prepare_mode = "stack"
)

#* Rarefy counts
#* @post /api/prepare/rarefy
#* @serializer unboxedJSON
function(req, res) {
  safe_api({

    session_id <- b$session_id
    experiment <- b$experiment
    sample_size<- as.integer(b$sample_size %||% 0L)

    mode <- b$prepare_mode %||% "stack"
    empt <- .prepare_load_base(session_id, experiment, mode = mode)
    args <- list(empt)
    if (sample_size > 0) args[["sample"]] <- sample_size
    empt <- do.call(EasyMultiProfiler::EMP_rrarefy, args)

    mae            <- load_mae(session_id)
    mae[[experiment]] <- empt
    save_mae(session_id, mae)
